title: Mall Upgrade to Luxury Mall
content: Hello all, happy holidays. I joined this forum because I have always had the same mall in my dreams (connected to a theater with a huge hall and lots of doors mind you. Sometimes it’s scary and sometimes it’s not) but also a college campus and beach and and a mansion with this beautiful pool where the sun is always setting that leads to the grounds of the campus. That pool is sometimes at the hotel I dream about but anyhoo… Last night I dreamt of a different mall and maybe I should wait to see if it happens again. But it was the same vibe as the other mall just a better mall. Lots of glass, greenery, and koi fish ponds and everything was just bright and clean. There was a court open to the sky and it was beautiful. I’m just sharing to see if this has happened to anyone else where you regular setting gets an upgrade? Also wondering what others thoughts are on the matter. Thanks for your time and thanks in advance for your input!
